name: Greenwood Restaurant
lede: Greenwood’s interior pairs mid-century modern lines with rustic warmth, and that character runs out onto the patio. Platinum gas heaters were chosen for their looks and their output, fitted around the tables and the traffic.

photos.caption: Photo: Gunn & Pegelow, via gunnpegelow.com. Permission to publish to be confirmed.

beats: An independent, design-led restaurant on Chicago’s North Shore, with an outdoor dining patio.
The heat had to suit the restaurant’s look and work with the patio’s table layout, traffic paths and heat requirements.
The team chose the Bromic Platinum gas heater. Gunn & Pegelow worked with WT Engineering to place each heater around the tables and paths.
